entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is contended on behalf of the accused-petitioner that no case for the alleged offences is made out against him and his incarceration is not warranted.
There are no factors at play in the case at hand that may work against grant of bail to the accused-petitioner and he has been made an accused based on conjectures and surmises.
The co-accused persons namely Rewant Ram and Sukhram have already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 27.03.2024.

4. Contrary to the submissions of learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application and submits that the present case is not fit for enlargement of accused on bail.
5. I Have considered the submissions made by both the parties and have perused the material available on record.
It is not disputed that the similarly situated co-accused persons Rewant Ram and Sukhram have already been enlarged on bail by this Court.
Thus, on the ground of parity and on the ground that the trial would still take a long time to conclude, it is deemed suitable to grant the benefit of bail to the petitioner in the present matter.

6. Accordingly, the instant bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner as named in the cause title shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court [2024:RJ-JD:41022] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-12076/2024] concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.

(FARJAND ALI),J 64-Samvedana/-
